description: This file defines API routes for KYC (Know Your Customer) case management using FastAPI framework. It includes endpoints for submitting new KYC cases with document uploads, listing cases for the current user or all users (admin only), and updating case status. It also contains internal utility functions for handling file uploads.

classes.name: KYCCase
classes.description: Represents a KYC case entity in the database, including user ID, personal info, document paths, status, and notes.

classes.name: KYCStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of possible statuses for a KYC case, such as PENDING, VERIFIED, and REJECTED.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the system, holds user-specific attributes like ID and username.

classes.name: KYCOut
classes.description: Response schema for KYC case data returned via API.

classes.name: KYCUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating the status and notes of a KYC case.

methods.name: Optional[str] _save_upload(file: Optional[UploadFile], subdir: str)
methods.description: Handles saving uploaded files to the server storage and returns the file path.

methods.name: create_kyc_case( full_name: str = Form(...), document_type: str = Form(...), document_number: str = Form(...), notes: Optional[str] = Form(None), document_file: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None), selfie_file: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: API endpoint for submitting a new KYC case with optional document and selfie uploads.

methods.name: list_my_kyc_cases(db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: API endpoint to list KYC cases submitted by the current user.

methods.name: list_all_kyc_cases(db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles(["admin"])))
methods.description: API endpoint to list all KYC cases; restricted to admin users.

methods.name: update_kyc_case(case_id: int, body: KYCUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), admin: User = Depends(require_roles(["admin"])))
methods.description: API endpoint to update status and notes of a specific KYC case; restricted to admin users.
